newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-KAREMBEU SET TO JOIN REAL MADRID, SAYS AGENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KAREMBEU SET TO JOIN REAL MADRID, SAYS AGENT.

text.p: French international striker Christian Karembeu is set to leave Italian club Sampdoria to join Real Madrid, a Spanish newspaper said on Tuesday.
"The two clubs are negotiating and although there are many differences, there are many ways for them to arrive at an agreement," his agent Milan Calasan said in the Spanish sports daily Marca.
His contract with Sampdoria expires at the end of next season but he has repeatedly said he wants to move as soon as possible after an unhappy time in Italy.
At one stage last season his club were discussing a transfer to Barcelona while he was trying to engineer his own move to rivals Real Madrid.
